messages:
elena: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down what we publish externally vs what stays internal. Recurring pattern: prefix/KV eviction under high concurrency showed up again. We should agree on owners + deadlines for a sanitized summary, SLA customer access to the full RCA, and the remediation timeline.

ciaran: +1. Proposal: draft an external summary (high-level + timeline) and a short FAQ, publish to the status page after legal review. Enterprise customers can get a redacted full RCA on request. Suggested deadlines: draft by Wed EOD, legal review within 24h, publish within 48-72h after approval.

jamie: I can own the draft. Will aim for Wed EOD. Need list of impacted endpoints and the short-term mitigations to include.

maya: Heads-up — Legal wants to review any wording that mentions internal mitigations. Add 24h review to the timeline.

samir: Ops note: remediation INF-4721 assigned to me (changes to batching/eviction heuristics). ETA ~2 weeks for the full fix. Short-term mitigations applied already (burst nodes + tuned cache TTL).

incident-bot: Created task INF-4721 and assigned to samir. Due date set to 2026-04-07.

product-comms: When drafting, include: 1) one-paragraph summary for status page, 2) what we did to reduce impact, 3) what customers can expect next, 4) contact channel for enterprise requests. We also want a 2-3 line FAQ.

jamie: Draft status page copy — first pass: 

```
During a high-concurrency event on 2026-03-22 we observed increased latency that caused timeouts for a subset of inference requests. We reduced impact by enabling burst capacity and reverting a recent optimization. We are investigating a long-term fix and will share follow-ups. Customers with SLA contracts may request a redacted RCA and timeline for remediation.
```

elena: This is a good start. Please remove the phrase "reverting a recent optimization" and replace with "reverted a recent optimization" (tense) and avoid implementation details. Also add a clear line: "No customer data was exposed."

samir: Agree with removing implementation specifics. Also add a brief note that we've deployed a short-term mitigation and are tracking a permanent fix.

product-comms: Legal review queued. I'll triage wording with legal and respond within 24 hours. Suggest we target publishing the sanitized summary to the status page 48-72 hours after Jamie's draft is approved.

maya: Legal ✅ on the sanitized wording including "reverted a recent optimization" and the "No customer data was exposed" statement.

elena: Action items recap (put in thread so trackers can copy):
- jamie: Draft external summary + 2-line FAQ (due: 2026-03-25) [owner: jamie]
- samir: Remediation follow-up & ETA for fix (INF-4721) (due: 2026-04-07) [owner: samir]
- product-comms: Coordinate legal review and publish status page update (due: 2026-03-26) [owner: product-comms]
- ciaran: Confirm list of SLA customers to proactively notify (due: 2026-03-25) [owner: ciaran]

Please update this thread when tasks are complete so I can close the postmortem follow-up loop.

jamie: I'll post the draft to #eng-sre shortly and link the status page draft here for review.

elena: Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-26 to check follow-up progress.
